title: SS27 Men's Trim Stories
summary: Trims that carry each SS27 men's theme: flat pockets and raw edges for Short Story, light construction for Ventilated Tailoring, embroidery and feathers for Tender Masculinity, piping for Pyjama Polish.

sections.heading: Short Story
sections.body: Flat patch pockets, raw edges on collarless truckers<sup>[1]</sup>, button-fly and elastic waists on boxer shorts.

sections.heading: Ventilated Tailoring
sections.body: Perforated and woven leather panels<sup>[2]</sup>, unlined construction, light horn and shell buttons.

sections.heading: Tender Masculinity
sections.body: Organza feathers and cornflower-blue embellishment at Simone Rocha<sup>[3]</sup>; embroidered florals; brooches.

sections.heading: Pyjama Polish
sections.body: Black collars and piping on khaki, blue and beige sets at Dior<sup>[4]</sup>; covered buttons; drawstrings.

design_implications: - One trim family per theme, used consistently.
commercial_implications: - Trims refresh core shirts and jackets without new patterns.
